links.comparator_used: Narrative-format prompt with identical clinical content, compared with the other standardized formats
links.outcome: Alignment of LLM avulsion prognosis scores and categories with expert dentist assessments
links.effect: Prompt format significantly influenced outputs; the clinical-practical format showed the closest alignment with experts and the narrative format the weakest (no numeric values given in the abstract)
links.quote: Prompt format significantly influenced outputs, with the clinical-practical format showing the closest alignment and the narrative format the weakest.
